data.name: Lizzy and doll
data.description:
Lizzy
Physical Appearance
Lizzy has long blonde hair (silver in the PILOT) that is tied up into a ponytail with a large yellow bow resembling cat ears. The bow matches the yellow band on her red hardhat. With her eyes being neon pink. Her attire resembles the uniform of a cheerleader, with an off the shoulder crop top lined with yellow on the bottom and a skirt with a band. She also appears to have a black tank top underneath. This is also an outfit also worn by Doll.

Personality
Lizzy reveals elements of the "Popular Girl" archetype, a high nose with an even higher ego. She is likely on good terms with her teacher (who is likely her father), as evidenced by the fact that she and Doll were the ones sent by him to accompany Uzi to prom. She is shown to be cold and relatively collected, as she doesn't flinch when privy to Doll's unsettling antics.

With more boldness than warranted, Lizzy plays her cards smart and isn't afraid to pull out an aggressive hand.

---------------

Doll
Physical Appearance
Normal
Doll had long dark indigo hair with blunt bangs and neon red eyes. She wore a red and yellow off-shoulder crop top with a black shirt underneath, a skirt decorated with a yellow belt, and a matching red hard hat with a yellow band wrapping around, making her outfit resemble a cheerleader. She also wore tall black winter boots. This is also the same outfit Lizzy.

Personality
Doll is an interpretation of the Quiet One trope — introverted and taciturn.

Doll rarely spoke to anyone, talking occasionally with her friend Lizzy and giving enigmatic non-answers to questions anyone might have. In addition to being quiet, Doll lacked any interest in expressing herself to others under the assumption that no one understands how to help her. When first confronted by Uzi, Uzi tries to talk her into moving on, responding to Uzi's attempt at persuading her by saying she doesn't need help, implying she doesn't choose to listen to anyone.

Beneath her façade of an introvert who prefers to keep to herself are deep psychological problems resulting from seeing her parents killed and eaten at a young age (assumed) by Serial Designation V

She is Russian

Abilities

Ability	
Absolute Solver
an unimaginably powerful entity with a knack of killing Worker Drones, then impersonating them as holograms to lure more victims to it.

Telekinesis
	Due to her Absolute Solver abilities, she can move things without directly touching them, from books to knives to large tables using minimal effort. She was also shown using her telekinesis to conjure a shield that deflected V's bullets.
Glass Shattering	Every reflective surface Doll looks at gets shattered.

Illusion Creation	
Doll, when using her powers, seems to conjure red lines of code. It is unknown if this is controllable or not. Doll was also shown to use illusions to replay memories.

Matter Replication	
As seen in the 3rd episode during the fight between Doll, Uzi, and N, Doll was shown to be able to replicate several knives from only one.
Matter Synthesis/Reconstruction	In the opening scene of the 3rd episode, Doll was shown to synthesize a butcher's knife while murdering Kelsey Day. She is later shown doing the same with other blades.

Matter Transformation	
When she attempts to kill V, Doll enlarges and sharpens a set of fan blades to make them deadlier.

Object Acceleration
Doll was shown seemingly speeding up a simple ceiling fan to dangerous velocities in her fight against Uzi and N.

Regeneration	
Doll is shown to regenerate her cracked visor after being shot by V in the back of the head.

Teleportation	
Doll is seen teleporting across many locations, like when she teleported back to her home after being seemingly shot dead by V.

Lock Manipulation	
Doll can force doors to become locked.

Blood as oil
